reads.sell: A plush Argentine Malbec from the high vineyards of Mendoza, with black plum, blueberry and violets over soft, ripe tannin and a touch of mocha. It was born for grilled steak and chimichurri.

why.grape: Inky purple with a magenta rim, violets and plush black and blue fruit, with acidity no higher than medium, is Malbec.
why.climate: Ripe, even jammy fruit and alcohol at medium plus or higher say a warm, sunny climate, freshened only by altitude.
